title: Deterministic kernel fixtures
responsibility: Builds repeatable synthetic graph requests and malformed input variants for cross-runtime comparisons.

inputs.name: kernelMutations.request
inputs.description: An impact runtime request whose input supplies base and head graphs plus changed, uncertain, and sink ids. The mutations copy or edit these fields, so the graph node and edge arrays and changed array must be present when a mutation reads them.

inputs.name: kernelMutations.count
inputs.description: The requested Array.from length for the returned variants. The 15 fixed mutations repeat in source order, and variants after the first cycle receive a round field; JavaScript length conversion applies without separate validation.

inputs.name: kernelWorkload.nodes
inputs.description: The number used to create original node ids and size the base graph. Zero yields empty base and head graphs and empty changed, uncertain, and sink lists; the implementation has no explicit range check.

inputs.name: kernelWorkload.seed
inputs.description: The seed is coerced to an unsigned 32-bit state before pseudo-random values are generated. Seeds that coerce to the same 32-bit value produce the same workload.

inputs.name: edges.size
inputs.description: The number of node positions used as edge endpoints. Iteration starts at position 1 and stops before size, so sizes at or below 1 return no edges; there is no explicit range check.

inputs.name: edges.next
inputs.description: A callback that supplies random values for parent selection and occasional reverse edges. It is called only during iterations with size greater than 1, and its return values are not range-checked.

outputs.name: kernelWorkload
outputs.description: Returns an impact request containing base and head graphs plus changed, uncertain, and sink id lists. Original ids use the n prefix, head additions use the a prefix, and the number of added ids is ceil(nodes × 0.03).

outputs.name: kernelMutations
outputs.description: Returns one variant per Array.from length unit, cycling through the 15 fixed mutations in source order. Variants after the first cycle also receive a round number starting at 1.

outputs.name: kernelTexts
outputs.description: Returns raw request text fixtures for parser edge cases, including numeric extremes, Unicode, nesting depth, duplicate keys, and malformed or non-object JSON. The fixtures are fixed strings rather than parsed requests.
